name: app.R
content:
# Flow cytometry clustering web tool.
#
# Input: one FCS file per sample, each already gated in FlowJo to the
# population of interest and exported. No gating happens here.
# Runs in R on a desktop (shiny::runApp("webtool/app")) or entirely in the
# browser through Shinylive / webR - files never leave the user's machine.
# Helpers in R/ are sourced automatically by Shiny.

library(shiny)
library(bslib)

# Shiny caps uploads at 5 MB by default. In the browser build nothing is sent
# to a server - the file is only copied into webR's memory - so the real limit
# is the browser tab's memory (webR is 32-bit WebAssembly, < 4 GB in total).
options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 1024^3)

PAL <- c("#2a78d6", "#e8743b", "#19a979", "#d64e8a", "#945ecf", "#13a4b4",
         "#b8860b", "#525df4", "#bf399e", "#6c8893", "#ee6868", "#2f6497",
         "#6db33f", "#a0522d", "#7a7a7a")
RAMP <- c("#cde2fb", "#9ec5f4", "#6da7ec", "#3987e5", "#256abf", "#184f95", "#0d366b")
DIV <- colorRampPalette(c("#2f6497", "#9ec5f4", "#f4f4f2", "#f2b28c", "#c4512b"))(41)

read_table_upload <- function(input_file) {
  if (is.null(input_file)) return(NULL)
  read.csv(input_file$datapath, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
}

safe_id <- function(prefix, i) paste0(prefix, "_", i)

ui <- page_navbar(
  id = "main",
  title = "Flow clustering",
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, primary = "#2a78d6", base_font = font_collection("system-ui", "sans-serif")),
  fillable = FALSE,
  header = tags$style(".cl-name .form-group, .cl-excl .form-group{margin-bottom:0} .cl-excl .checkbox{margin:0}"),

  nav_panel("1 · Data",
    layout_columns(col_widths = c(5, 7),
      card(
        card_header("Upload"),
        p(class = "text-muted small",
          "One FCS file per sample and gate, exported from FlowJo",
          "(right-click the gate → Export / Concatenate Populations → FCS, all compensated parameters).",
          "You can load several gates at once (e.g. Q2 and CD8 for every sample) and choose which to analyse.",
          "Files are read in your browser and are not uploaded anywhere."),
        fileInput("fcs", "FCS files", multiple = TRUE, accept = ".fcs"),
        fileInput("samples_csv", "Sample table (optional CSV: file, sample, population, group)", accept = ".csv"),
        fileInput("panel_csv", "Panel table (optional CSV: channel, marker, use)", accept = ".csv"),
        uiOutput("load_msg"),
        uiOutput("pop_select")
      ),
      card(
        card_header("Files"),
        p(class = "text-muted small",
          "Sample and population are read from FlowJo's export_<sample>_<gate>.fcs names - edit them if the guess is wrong.",
          "Check the event counts against FlowJo."),
        uiOutput("sample_editor"),
        card_header("Groups"),
        p(class = "text-muted small",
          "Experimental group of each sample (e.g. control / treated). Proportions are averaged per group."),
        uiOutput("group_editor")
      )
    )
  ),

  nav_panel("2 · Channels",
    card(
      card_header("Channels used for UMAP and clustering"),
      p(class = "text-muted small",
        "Untick scatter, time, viability and the channels you gated on - they only tell the",
        "map what you already selected. Marker names are taken from the panel table, the FCS",
        "$PnS keyword, or the channel name, in that order."),
      div(class = "d-flex gap-2 mb-2",
        actionButton("ch_all", "Select all", class = "btn-sm btn-outline-secondary"),
        actionButton("ch_none", "Select none", class = "btn-sm btn-outline-secondary"),
        downloadButton("dl_panel", "Save as panel.csv", class = "btn-sm btn-outline-secondary")),
      uiOutput("channel_editor")
    )
  ),

  nav_panel("3 · Run",
    layout_columns(col_widths = c(4, 8),
      card(
        card_header("Parameters"),
        numericInput("cofactor", "arcsinh cofactor", 6000, min = 1, step = 500),
        numericInput("max_per", "Max cells per sample (downsample)", 5000, min = 50, step = 1000),
        numericInput("nn", "UMAP n_neighbors", 15, min = 2, max = 200),
        numericInput("md", "UMAP min_dist", 0.1, min = 0, max = 1, step = 0.05),
        layout_columns(
          numericInput("xdim", "SOM x", 8, min = 2, max = 20),
          numericInput("ydim", "SOM y", 8, min = 2, max = 20)),
        checkboxInput("balanced", "Train SOM on equal cells per sample", TRUE),
        numericInput("maxk", "Max k to compute", 15, min = 2, max = 30),
        numericInput("seed", "Random seed", 42),
        actionButton("run", "Run analysis", class = "btn-primary w-100"),
        uiOutput("run_estimate")
      ),
      card(
        card_header("Status"),
        verbatimTextOutput("run_log")
      )
    )
  ),

  nav_panel("4 · Results",
    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(width = 280,
        sliderInput("k", "Number of clusters (k)", min = 2, max = 15, value = 6, step = 1),
        selectInput("colour_by", "Colour UMAP by", choices = c("cluster", "sample")),
        uiOutput("cluster_editor")
      ),
      navset_card_underline(
        nav_panel("UMAP", plotOutput("umap_plot", height = "620px")),
        nav_panel("By sample", plotOutput("facet_plot", height = "700px")),
        nav_panel("Markers", plotOutput("heatmap", height = "560px"),
                  tableOutput("cluster_table")),
        nav_panel("Proportions",
                  plotOutput("prop_plot", height = "460px"),
                  p(class = "text-muted small",
                    "Bars are the mean across samples (± SEM) - not pooled cells, so one large sample cannot set the answer.",
                    "Clusters marked 'exclude' are dropped before the percentages are computed."),
                  tableOutput("prop_table")),
        nav_panel("Download",
          p("Everything is computed in this browser session. Download what you need before closing the tab."),
          downloadButton("dl_cells", "Per-cell table (UMAP, cluster, markers)"), br(), br(),
          downloadButton("dl_markers", "Cluster marker table"), br(), br(),
          downloadButton("dl_props", "Cluster proportions per sample"), br(), br(),
          downloadButton("dl_params", "Run parameters"))
      )
    )
  ),
  nav_spacer(),
  nav_item(tags$span(class = "text-muted small", "runs locally · no data leaves this computer"))
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  rv <- reactiveValues(fcs = NULL, ch = NULL, res = NULL, log = "No run yet.")

  # ---- data -----------------------------------------------------------------
  observeEvent(input$fcs, {
    f <- input$fcs
    out <- tryCatch({
      lst <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(f)), function(i) {
        x <- fcs_read(f$datapath[i]); x$file <- f$name[i]; x
      })
      names(lst) <- sub("\\.fcs$", "", f$name, ignore.case = TRUE)
      ch <- channel_table(lst)
      list(lst = lst, ch = ch)
    }, error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(out, "error")) {
      rv$fcs <- NULL; rv$ch <- NULL
      output$load_msg <- renderUI(div(class = "alert alert-danger", conditionMessage(out)))
      return()
    }
    rv$fcs <- out$lst
    rv$ch <- apply_panel(out$ch, read_table_upload(input$panel_csv))
    rv$res <- NULL
    output$load_msg <- renderUI(div(class = "alert alert-success",
      sprintf("Read %d files, %s events, %d channels.", length(out$lst),
              format(sum(sapply(out$lst, function(x) nrow(x$exprs))), big.mark = ","),
              nrow(out$ch))))
  })

  observeEvent(input$panel_csv, {
    req(rv$ch)
    rv$ch <- apply_panel(rv$ch, read_table_upload(input$panel_csv))
  })

  # one row per file: sample and population guessed from the FlowJo export
  # name, overridden by the sample table, then by edits in the Files card
  sample_meta <- reactive({
    req(rv$fcs)
    files <- vapply(rv$fcs, `[[`, "", "file")
    guess <- parse_export_name(files)
    sample <- guess$sample; population <- guess$population
    group <- rep(NA_character_, length(files))
    st <- read_table_upload(input$samples_csv)
    if (!is.null(st)) {
      names(st) <- tolower(names(st))
      i <- if ("file" %in% names(st)) match(files, st$file) else rep(NA_integer_, length(files))
      hit <- !is.na(i)
      if ("sample" %in% names(st)) sample[hit] <- st$sample[i[hit]]
      if ("population" %in% names(st)) population[hit] <- st$population[i[hit]]
      if ("group" %in% names(st)) group[hit] <- st$group[i[hit]]
    }
    data.frame(file = files, sample = sample, population = population, group = group,
               events = vapply(rv$fcs, function(x) nrow(x$exprs), 1L),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })

  files_now <- reactive({
    m <- sample_meta()
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(m))) {
      v <- input[[safe_id("sname", i)]]; if (!is.null(v) && nzchar(v)) m$sample[i] <- v
      p <- input[[safe_id("spop", i)]]; if (!is.null(p) && nzchar(p)) m$population[i] <- p
    }
    m
  })

  output$sample_editor <- renderUI({
    m <- sample_meta()
    rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(m)), function(i) tags$tr(
      tags$td(class = "small", m$file[i]),
      tags$td(class = "text-end small", format(m$events[i], big.mark = ",")),
      tags$td(textInput(safe_id("sname", i), NULL, m$sample[i], width = "110px")),
      tags$td(textInput(safe_id("spop", i), NULL, m$population[i], width = "130px"))))
    tags$table(class = "table table-sm align-middle",
      tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("File"), tags$th(class = "text-end", "Events"),
                         tags$th("Sample"), tags$th("Population"))),
      tags$tbody(rows))
  })

  # group is a property of the sample, so it is edited once per sample even
  # when the sample has several populations loaded
  group_defaults <- reactive({
    m <- files_now()
    s <- unique(m$sample)
    g <- vapply(s, function(x) {
      v <- m$group[m$sample == x]; v <- v[!is.na(v) & nzchar(v)]
      if (length(v)) v[1] else "all"
    }, "")
    data.frame(sample = s, group = unname(g), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })

  output$group_editor <- renderUI({
    gd <- group_defaults()
    rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(gd)), function(j) tags$tr(
      tags$td(class = "small", gd$sample[j]),
      tags$td(textInput(safe_id("sgroup", j), NULL,
                        isolate(input[[safe_id("sgroup", j)]]) %||% gd$group[j], width = "140px"))))
    tags$table(class = "table table-sm align-middle",
      tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("Sample"), tags$th("Group"))), tags$tbody(rows))
  })

  groups_now <- reactive({
    gd <- group_defaults()
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(gd))) {
      g <- input[[safe_id("sgroup", j)]]; if (!is.null(g) && nzchar(g)) gd$group[j] <- g
    }
    setNames(gd$group, gd$sample)
  })

  # The population list only changes when files or population names change.
  # Keeping it in a reactiveVal (which ignores identical updates) stops the
  # radio buttons re-rendering - and losing the user's choice - whenever a
  # sample name is edited.
  pop_list <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  observe({
    p <- files_now()$population
    v <- list(pops = unique(p), n = as.integer(table(factor(p, levels = unique(p)))))
    if (!identical(v, isolate(pop_list()))) pop_list(v)
  })
  populations <- reactive(pop_list()$pops)

  output$pop_select <- renderUI({
    v <- pop_list(); req(v)
    cur <- isolate(input$population)
    radioButtons("population", "Population to analyse",
                 choiceNames = sprintf("%s  (%d files)", v$pops, v$n),
                 choiceValues = v$pops,
                 selected = if (isTRUE(cur %in% v$pops)) cur else v$pops[1])
  })

  # the files of the chosen population, with their sample names and groups
  samples_now <- reactive({
    m <- files_now()
    pop <- input$population
    if (is.null(pop) || !pop %in% m$population) pop <- m$population[1]
    m$idx <- seq_len(nrow(m))
    m <- m[m$population == pop, , drop = FALSE]
    m$group <- unname(groups_now()[m$sample])
    m$pop <- pop
    m
  })

  # ---- channels ---------------------------------------------------------------
  output$channel_editor <- renderUI({
    ch <- rv$ch
    if (is.null(ch)) return(p(class = "text-muted", "Load FCS files first."))
    rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ch)), function(i) tags$tr(
      tags$td(checkboxInput(safe_id("use", i), NULL, ch$use[i])),
      tags$td(class = "small", ch$channel[i]),
      tags$td(textInput(safe_id("mk", i), NULL, ch$marker[i], width = "180px"))))
    tags$table(class = "table table-sm align-middle",
      tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("Use"), tags$th("Channel"), tags$th("Marker"))),
      tags$tbody(rows))
  })
  observeEvent(input$ch_all, { req(rv$ch); for (i in seq_len(nrow(rv$ch))) updateCheckboxInput(session, safe_id("use", i), value = TRUE) })
  observeEvent(input$ch_none, { req(rv$ch); for (i in seq_len(nrow(rv$ch))) updateCheckboxInput(session, safe_id("use", i), value = FALSE) })

  channels_now <- reactive({
    ch <- rv$ch; req(ch)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(ch))) {
      u <- input[[safe_id("use", i)]]; if (!is.null(u)) ch$use[i] <- u
      m <- input[[safe_id("mk", i)]]; if (!is.null(m) && nzchar(m)) ch$marker[i] <- m
    }
    ch$marker <- make.unique(ch$marker)
    ch
  })

  output$dl_panel <- downloadHandler("panel.csv", function(file)
    write.csv(channels_now(), file, row.names = FALSE))

  # ---- run ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Measured in Chrome via webR: UMAP ~20 s per 10,000 cells (7 s for 1,888,
  # 68 s for 40,000, 298 s for 160,000); everything else is small.
  run_size <- reactive({
    ev <- samples_now()$events
    mp <- input$max_per
    if (is.null(mp) || is.na(mp)) mp <- Inf
    n <- sum(pmin(ev, mp))
    sec <- 5 + n / 10000 * 20
    label <- if (sec < 60) sprintf("%.0f s", max(5, round(sec, -1))) else sprintf("%.0f min", ceiling(sec / 60))
    list(n = n, sec = sec, label = label)
  })
  output$run_estimate <- renderUI({
    req(rv$fcs)
    e <- run_size()
    div(class = paste("small mt-2", if (e$sec > 180) "text-danger" else "text-muted"),
        sprintf("Population '%s': %s cells will be analysed - about %s in the browser.",
                samples_now()$pop[1], format(e$n, big.mark = ","), e$label),
        if (e$sec > 180) " Lower 'Max cells per sample' to explore parameters first.")
  })

  observeEvent(input$run, {
    req(rv$fcs)
    ch <- channels_now()
    if (sum(ch$use) < 2) { rv$log <- "Select at least two channels."; return() }
    m <- samples_now()
    if (anyDuplicated(m$sample)) {
      rv$log <- sprintf("Population '%s' has more than one file for sample(s) %s. Fix the sample or population names in 1 · Data.",
                        m$pop[1], paste(unique(m$sample[duplicated(m$sample)]), collapse = ", "))
      return()
    }
    fcs <- rv$fcs[m$idx]; names(fcs) <- m$sample
    t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
    est <- run_size()
    withProgress(message = "Running", value = 0, {
      res <- tryCatch(run_pipeline(fcs, ch,
        cofactor = input$cofactor, max_per_sample = input$max_per,
        n_neighbors = input$nn, min_dist = input$md,
        xdim = input$xdim, ydim = input$ydim, balanced = input$balanced,
        max_k = input$maxk, seed = input$seed,
        progress = function(msg) incProgress(0.25, detail = if (msg == "UMAP")
          sprintf("UMAP on %s cells - about %s, no progress is shown until it finishes",
                  format(est$n, big.mark = ","), est$label) else msg)),
        error = function(e) e)
    })
    if (inherits(res, "error")) { rv$log <- paste("Error:", conditionMessage(res)); return() }
    res$groups <- setNames(m$group, names(fcs))
    res$params$population <- m$pop[1]
    rv$res <- res
    kmax <- length(res$consensus) + 1
    updateSliderInput(session, "k", max = kmax, value = min(isolate(input$k), kmax))
    updateSelectInput(session, "colour_by", choices = c("cluster", "sample", res$params$markers))
    rv$log <- sprintf(paste0("Population '%s'\n",
                             "Done in %.1f s  (UMAP %.1f s, clustering %.1f s)\n",
                             "%s cells from %d samples, %d markers\n",
                             "SOM %dx%d trained on %s cells%s\n\nGo to 4 · Results."),
      m$pop[1], proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0, res$timing[["umap"]], res$timing[["cluster"]],
      format(length(res$sample), big.mark = ","), length(unique(res$sample)),
      ncol(res$expr), res$params$xdim, res$params$ydim,
      format(res$som$n_train, big.mark = ","),
      if (res$params$balanced) " (balanced per sample)" else "")
    nav_select("main", "4 · Results")
  })
  output$run_log <- renderText(rv$log)

  # ---- results ------------------------------------------------------------------
  cl <- reactive({ req(rv$res); clusters_at(rv$res, input$k) })

  cluster_names <- reactive({
    k <- input$k
    nm <- vapply(seq_len(k), function(i) {
      v <- input[[paste0("cname_", k, "_", i)]]
      if (is.null(v) || !nzchar(v)) paste0("C", i) else v
    }, "")
    nm
  })
  excluded <- reactive({
    k <- input$k
    which(vapply(seq_len(k), function(i) isTRUE(input[[paste0("cexcl_", k, "_", i)]]), TRUE))
  })

  output$cluster_editor <- renderUI({
    req(rv$res); k <- input$k
    tagList(tags$label(class = "form-label", "Cluster names / exclude"),
      lapply(seq_len(k), function(i) div(class = "d-flex align-items-center gap-2 mb-1",
        span(style = sprintf("width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:2px;background:%s;flex:none", PAL[(i - 1) %% length(PAL) + 1])),
        div(style = "flex:1;min-width:0", class = "cl-name", textInput(paste0("cname_", k, "_", i), NULL, width = "100%",
                                        isolate(input[[paste0("cname_", k, "_", i)]]) %||% paste0("C", i))),
        div(class = "cl-excl", checkboxInput(paste0("cexcl_", k, "_", i), "excl.",
                                             isolate(input[[paste0("cexcl_", k, "_", i)]]) %||% FALSE)))))
  })

  umap_lims <- reactive({ req(rv$res); apply(rv$res$umap, 2, range) })

  draw_umap <- function(xy, col, main = NULL, cex = 0.5) {
    lim <- umap_lims()
    plot(xy, col = col, pch = 16, cex = cex, asp = 1, xlim = lim[, 1], ylim = lim[, 2],
         axes = FALSE, xlab = "UMAP1", ylab = "UMAP2", main = main, font.main = 1)
    box(col = "#e4e4e0")
  }

  output$umap_plot <- renderPlot({
    res <- rv$res; req(res)
    par(mar = c(3, 3, 2, 10), mgp = c(1.5, 0.5, 0), xpd = NA)
    by <- input$colour_by
    if (by == "cluster") {
      cc <- cl(); nm <- cluster_names()
      draw_umap(res$umap, PAL[(cc - 1) %% length(PAL) + 1], sprintf("k = %d", input$k))
      sz <- tabulate(cc, input$k)
      legend("topright", inset = c(-0.32, 0), bty = "n", pch = 16, col = PAL[seq_len(input$k)],
             legend = sprintf("%s  (%d)", nm, sz), cex = 0.9)
    } else if (by == "sample") {
      s <- factor(res$sample)
      draw_umap(res$umap, PAL[(as.integer(s) - 1) %% length(PAL) + 1], "by sample")
      legend("topright", inset = c(-0.32, 0), bty = "n", pch = 16,
             col = PAL[seq_along(levels(s))], legend = levels(s), cex = 0.9)
    } else {
      v <- res$expr[, by]
      q <- quantile(v, c(0.02, 0.98)); s <- pmin(pmax((v - q[1]) / diff(q), 0), 1)
      o <- order(s)
      ramp <- colorRampPalette(RAMP)(100)
      draw_umap(res$umap[o, ], ramp[1 + floor(99 * s[o])], paste(by, "(2nd-98th percentile)"))
      legend("topright", inset = c(-0.32, 0), bty = "n", pch = 15, col = ramp[c(1, 50, 100)],
             legend = c("low", "", "high"), cex = 0.9)
    }
  })

  output$facet_plot <- renderPlot({
    res <- rv$res; req(res)
    s <- unique(res$sample); n <- length(s)
    nc <- ceiling(sqrt(n)); nr <- ceiling(n / nc)
    par(mfrow = c(nr, nc), mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
    cc <- cl()
    for (x in s) {
      i <- res$sample == x
      draw_umap(res$umap, "#dcdcd8", sprintf("%s  (n = %d)", x, sum(i)), cex = 0.3)
      points(res$umap[i, , drop = FALSE], pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = PAL[(cc[i] - 1) %% length(PAL) + 1])
    }
  })

  markers_k <- reactive({ req(rv$res); cluster_markers(rv$res$expr, cl()) })

  output$heatmap <- renderPlot({
    cm <- markers_k(); z <- pmin(pmax(cm$z, -2), 2)
    nm <- cluster_names()[as.integer(rownames(z))]
    par(mar = c(7, 9, 2, 2))
    image(t(z[nrow(z):1, , drop = FALSE]), col = DIV, zlim = c(-2, 2), axes = FALSE,
          main = "Cluster median vs all cells (SD units, clipped at ±2)", font.main = 1)
    axis(1, at = seq(0, 1, length.out = ncol(z)), labels = colnames(z), las = 2, tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.85)
    axis(2, at = seq(0, 1, length.out = nrow(z)), labels = rev(sprintf("%s (%d)", nm, tabulate(cl(), input$k))),
         las = 1, tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.9)
  })

  output$cluster_table <- renderTable({
    cm <- markers_k(); s <- cluster_summary(cm, cl())
    s$cluster <- cluster_names()[as.integer(s$cluster)]
    names(s) <- c("Cluster", "Cells", "%", "Highest AUC vs rest", "Lowest AUC vs rest")
    s
  }, striped = TRUE, spacing = "s")

  props <- reactive({
    req(rv$res)
    cc <- factor(cluster_names()[cl()], levels = cluster_names())
    cluster_proportions(rv$res$sample, cc, rv$res$groups,
                        exclude = cluster_names()[excluded()])
  })

  output$prop_plot <- renderPlot({
    p <- props()$summary
    p <- p[p$cluster %in% setdiff(cluster_names(), cluster_names()[excluded()]), ]
    p$cluster <- factor(p$cluster, levels = cluster_names())
    mm <- tapply(p$mean, list(p$group, p$cluster), sum)
    se <- tapply(p$sem, list(p$group, p$cluster), sum)
    mm <- mm[, colSums(!is.na(mm)) > 0, drop = FALSE]
    se <- se[, colnames(mm), drop = FALSE]
    gcol <- colorRampPalette(c("#2a78d6", "#e8743b", "#19a979", "#945ecf"))(max(2, nrow(mm)))[seq_len(nrow(mm))]
    par(mar = c(5, 4, 2, 1))
    bp <- barplot(mm, beside = TRUE, col = gcol, border = NA, las = 2,
                  ylim = c(0, max(mm + se, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15), ylab = "% of cells (mean across samples)",
                  legend.text = if (nrow(mm) > 1) rownames(mm) else NULL,
                  args.legend = list(bty = "n", border = NA))
    ok <- !is.na(se)
    arrows(bp[ok], (mm - se)[ok], bp[ok], (mm + se)[ok], angle = 90, code = 3, length = 0.03, col = "#52514e")
  })

  output$prop_table <- renderTable(props()$per_sample, striped = TRUE, spacing = "s", digits = 1)

  # ---- downloads ------------------------------------------------------------------
  output$dl_cells <- downloadHandler("cells.csv", function(file) {
    res <- rv$res
    d <- data.frame(sample = res$sample, UMAP1 = res$umap[, 1], UMAP2 = res$umap[, 2],
                    som_node = res$som$node, cluster = cluster_names()[cl()], res$expr,
                    check.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(d, file, row.names = FALSE)
  })
  output$dl_markers <- downloadHandler("cluster_markers.csv", function(file) {
    cm <- markers_k(); nm <- cluster_names()[as.integer(rownames(cm$z))]
    d <- rbind(data.frame(cluster = nm, stat = "median", cm$median, check.names = FALSE),
               data.frame(cluster = nm, stat = "z_vs_all", cm$z, check.names = FALSE),
               data.frame(cluster = nm, stat = "auc_vs_rest", cm$auc, check.names = FALSE))
    write.csv(d, file, row.names = FALSE)
  })
  output$dl_props <- downloadHandler("cluster_proportions.csv", function(file) {
    p <- props()
    write.csv(p$per_sample, file, row.names = FALSE)
  })
  output$dl_params <- downloadHandler("run_parameters.txt", function(file) {
    p <- rv$res$params
    lines <- c(sprintf("date: %s", format(Sys.time())),
               sprintf("k: %d", input$k),
               sprintf("%s: %s", names(p), vapply(p, function(x) paste(x, collapse = "; "), "")),
               sprintf("cluster names: %s", paste(cluster_names(), collapse = "; ")),
               sprintf("excluded: %s", paste(cluster_names()[excluded()], collapse = "; ")),
               sprintf("samples: %s", paste(sprintf("%s=%s", names(rv$res$groups), rv$res$groups), collapse = "; ")))
    writeLines(lines, file)
  })
}

name: R/fcs.R
content:
# Minimal FCS 3.0 / 3.1 reader in base R.
#
# flowCore has no WebAssembly build, so the web tool cannot use it. This reads
# the HEADER, the TEXT keywords and the DATA segment directly. It covers what
# FlowJo and the Cytek Aurora write: list mode, float / double / fixed-width
# integer data, either byte order.

fcs_read <- function(path, max_events = Inf) {
  con <- file(path, "rb")
  on.exit(close(con))
  size <- file.info(path)$size

  header <- rawToChar(readBin(con, "raw", 58))
  version <- substr(header, 1, 6)
  if (!grepl("^FCS[23]\\.", version))
    stop(basename(path), ": not an FCS file (header '", version, "')")
  off <- function(a, b) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trimws(substr(header, a, b))))
  text_begin <- off(11, 18); text_end <- off(19, 26)
  data_begin <- off(27, 34); data_end <- off(35, 42)

  seek(con, text_begin)
  txt_raw <- readBin(con, "raw", text_end - text_begin + 1)
  kw <- fcs_parse_text(txt_raw)

  # offsets past 99,999,999 bytes do not fit the header and live in TEXT
  if (is.na(data_begin) || data_begin == 0 || data_end == 0) {
    data_begin <- as.numeric(kw[["$BEGINDATA"]])
    data_end   <- as.numeric(kw[["$ENDDATA"]])
  }

  if (!is.null(kw[["$MODE"]]) && toupper(kw[["$MODE"]]) != "L")
    stop(basename(path), ": only list-mode FCS is supported")

  npar <- as.integer(kw[["$PAR"]])
  ntot <- as.integer(kw[["$TOT"]])
  dtype <- toupper(kw[["$DATATYPE"]])
  byteord <- gsub("\\s", "", kw[["$BYTEORD"]])
  endian <- if (byteord %in% c("1,2,3,4", "1,2")) "little" else "big"

  pkey <- function(i, s) { v <- kw[[sprintf("$P%d%s", i, s)]]; if (is.null(v)) "" else v }
  pn <- vapply(seq_len(npar), pkey, "", s = "N")
  ps <- vapply(seq_len(npar), pkey, "", s = "S")
  pb <- as.integer(vapply(seq_len(npar), pkey, "", s = "B"))

  n_read <- min(ntot, max_events)
  seek(con, data_begin)
  vals <- switch(dtype,
    "F" = readBin(con, "numeric", n = npar * n_read, size = 4, endian = endian),
    "D" = readBin(con, "numeric", n = npar * n_read, size = 8, endian = endian),
    "I" = {
      if (length(unique(pb)) != 1 || !pb[1] %in% c(8, 16, 32))
        stop(basename(path), ": mixed or unusual integer widths are not supported")
      v <- readBin(con, "integer", n = npar * n_read, size = pb[1] / 8,
                   signed = pb[1] == 32, endian = endian)
      if (pb[1] == 32) v[v < 0] <- v[v < 0] + 2^32
      # honour $PnR bit masks for 16-bit data
      as.numeric(v)
    },
    stop(basename(path), ": $DATATYPE '", dtype, "' not supported")
  )
  if (length(vals) != npar * n_read)
    stop(basename(path), ": DATA segment shorter than $TOT x $PAR")

  m <- matrix(vals, ncol = npar, byrow = TRUE)
  colnames(m) <- pn
  list(
    exprs = m,
    params = data.frame(name = pn, desc = ps, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    keywords = kw,
    n_total = ntot,
    file = basename(path)
  )
}

# TEXT segment: the first byte is the delimiter; a doubled delimiter inside a
# value is an escaped literal (FCS forbids empty values, so a doubled
# delimiter is never two separators).
fcs_parse_text <- function(raw) {
  raw <- raw[raw != as.raw(0)]
  delim <- rawToChar(raw[1])
  txt <- rawToChar(raw[-1])
  Encoding(txt) <- "latin1"
  txt <- enc2utf8(txt)
  ph <- "\u0001"
  txt <- gsub(paste0(delim, delim), ph, txt, fixed = TRUE)
  tok <- strsplit(txt, delim, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  tok <- gsub(ph, delim, tok, fixed = TRUE)
  if (length(tok) %% 2 == 1) tok <- tok[-length(tok)]
  keys <- toupper(trimws(tok[c(TRUE, FALSE)]))
  vals <- tok[c(FALSE, TRUE)]
  stats::setNames(as.list(vals), keys)
}

name: R/pipeline.R
content:
# Analysis core for the web tool. Only uses packages that have WebAssembly
# builds in the webR repository (uwot, kohonen) plus base R, so the same code
# runs in R on a desktop and in the browser.

# ---- input -------------------------------------------------------------------

# Channel table for a set of FCS files: name, FCS description ($PnS), and a
# guess at whether it is a fluorescence parameter worth analysing.
channel_table <- function(fcs_list) {
  # the channel set most files share is the reference, so one odd file (a
  # concatenated file, a control) is named instead of everything else
  keys <- vapply(fcs_list, function(f) paste(f$params$name, collapse = "\r"), "")
  ref <- names(sort(table(keys), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  p <- fcs_list[[match(ref, keys)]]$params
  same <- keys == ref
  if (!all(same)) {
    msg <- vapply(names(fcs_list)[!same], function(s) {
      nm <- fcs_list[[s]]$params$name
      extra <- setdiff(nm, p$name); missing <- setdiff(p$name, nm)
      show <- function(x) if (length(x) > 3) paste0(paste(x[1:3], collapse = ", "), ", ... (", length(x), ")") else paste(x, collapse = ", ")
      sprintf("%s - %d channels vs %d%s%s", s, length(nm), length(p$name),
              if (length(extra)) paste0("; extra: ", show(extra)) else "",
              if (length(missing)) paste0("; missing: ", show(missing)) else "")
    }, "")
    stop(sprintf("%d of %d files do not match the channels of the other %d: %s. ",
                 sum(!same), length(same), sum(same), paste(msg, collapse = " | ")),
         "Remove them (concatenated files and controls usually differ), ",
         "or re-export every sample with the same FlowJo settings.")
  }
  skip <- grepl("^(FSC|SSC|Time|Event|AF|Original|Sample|Width|Height)",
                p$name, ignore.case = TRUE) |
          grepl("-(H|W)$", p$name)
  data.frame(channel = p$name,
             marker = ifelse(nzchar(p$desc), p$desc, p$name),
             use = !skip,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# FlowJo names exports "export_<sample>_<population>.fcs". Split that into
# sample and population; anything else is one sample of population "all".
parse_export_name <- function(file) {
  stem <- sub("^export_", "", sub("[.]fcs$", "", file, ignore.case = TRUE))
  has <- grepl("_", stem)
  data.frame(sample = ifelse(has, sub("_[^_]*$", "", stem), stem),
             population = ifelse(has, sub("^.*_", "", stem), "all"),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Merge an uploaded panel table (channel, marker[, use]) into the channel table.
apply_panel <- function(ch, panel) {
  if (is.null(panel)) return(ch)
  names(panel) <- tolower(names(panel))
  i <- match(ch$channel, panel$channel)
  hit <- !is.na(i)
  if ("marker" %in% names(panel)) ch$marker[hit] <- panel$marker[i[hit]]
  if ("use" %in% names(panel))
    ch$use[hit] <- as.logical(panel$use[i[hit]])
  ch
}

asinh_tf <- function(x, cofactor) asinh(x / cofactor)

# Stack the selected channels of every sample, transformed, optionally
# downsampled per sample.
build_matrix <- function(fcs_list, channels, markers, cofactor = 6000,
                         max_per_sample = Inf, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  parts <- lapply(names(fcs_list), function(s) {
    m <- fcs_list[[s]]$exprs[, channels, drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(m) > max_per_sample) m <- m[sort(sample.int(nrow(m), max_per_sample)), , drop = FALSE]
    list(sample = rep(s, nrow(m)), m = m)
  })
  raw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(parts, `[[`, "m"))
  colnames(raw) <- markers
  expr <- if (is.function(cofactor)) cofactor(raw) else asinh_tf(raw, cofactor)
  list(sample = unlist(lapply(parts, `[[`, "sample")), raw = raw, expr = expr)
}

zscore <- function(x) {
  z <- scale(x)
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  z
}

# ---- embedding ---------------------------------------------------------------

run_umap <- function(Z, n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.1, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  uwot::umap(Z, n_neighbors = min(n_neighbors, nrow(Z) - 1), min_dist = min_dist,
             metric = "euclidean", n_threads = 1, n_sgd_threads = 1)
}

# ---- clustering --------------------------------------------------------------

# SOM trained on an equal number of cells per sample (so one large sample
# cannot claim private nodes), then every cell mapped to its nearest node.
run_som <- function(Z, sample, xdim = 8, ydim = 8, balanced = TRUE, rlen = 10,
                    seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  idx <- seq_len(nrow(Z))
  train <- if (balanced) {
    per <- min(table(sample))
    unlist(lapply(split(idx, sample), function(i) i[sample.int(length(i), per)]))
  } else idx
  grid <- kohonen::somgrid(xdim, ydim, topo = "rectangular")
  som <- kohonen::som(Z[train, , drop = FALSE], grid = grid, rlen = rlen,
                      alpha = c(0.05, 0.01))
  codes <- som$codes[[1]]
  list(codes = codes, node = nearest_node(Z, codes), n_train = length(train))
}

nearest_node <- function(Z, codes) {
  # squared euclidean distance via the expansion |a|^2 - 2ab + |b|^2
  d <- -2 * Z %*% t(codes)
  d <- sweep(d, 2, rowSums(codes^2), "+")
  max.col(-d, ties.method = "first")
}

# Consensus hierarchical clustering of the SOM nodes, as ConsensusClusterPlus
# does with clusterAlg = "hc": resample pItem of the nodes `reps` times,
# average-linkage cluster each subsample, and record how often each pair of
# nodes lands together. The final partition clusters 1 - consensus.
# Returns one node -> metacluster vector per k in 2..max_k.
consensus_hc <- function(codes, max_k = 15, reps = 100, p_item = 0.9, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(codes)
  max_k <- min(max_k, n - 1)
  ks <- 2:max_k
  M <- lapply(ks, function(k) matrix(0, n, n))
  I <- matrix(0, n, n)
  D <- as.matrix(dist(codes))
  for (r in seq_len(reps)) {
    s <- sort(sample.int(n, floor(n * p_item)))
    hc <- hclust(as.dist(D[s, s]), method = "average")
    I[s, s] <- I[s, s] + 1
    for (j in seq_along(ks)) {
      cl <- cutree(hc, ks[j])
      M[[j]][s, s] <- M[[j]][s, s] + outer(cl, cl, "==")
    }
  }
  out <- lapply(seq_along(ks), function(j) {
    C <- M[[j]] / pmax(I, 1)
    diag(C) <- 1
    hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - C), method = "average")
    relabel_by_size(cutree(hc, ks[j]))
  })
  names(out) <- ks
  out
}

# Number clusters 1..k from largest to smallest, so labels are stable to read.
relabel_by_size <- function(cl) {
  o <- order(-tabulate(cl))
  match(cl, o)
}

# ---- description -------------------------------------------------------------

# Per-cluster median of each marker (transformed scale), scored against ALL
# cells: (cluster median - overall median) / overall SD, plus AUC of the
# cluster vs every other cell.
cluster_markers <- function(expr, cluster) {
  centre <- apply(expr, 2, median)
  spread <- apply(expr, 2, sd)
  spread[spread == 0] <- 1
  cl <- sort(unique(cluster))
  med <- t(sapply(cl, function(k) apply(expr[cluster == k, , drop = FALSE], 2, median)))
  if (length(cl) == 1) med <- matrix(med, nrow = 1, dimnames = list(NULL, colnames(expr)))
  rownames(med) <- cl
  z <- sweep(sweep(med, 2, centre), 2, spread, "/")
  auc <- t(sapply(cl, function(k) {
    inn <- cluster == k
    apply(expr, 2, function(v) {
      r <- rank(v)
      n1 <- sum(inn); n0 <- sum(!inn)
      if (n0 == 0) return(NA_real_)
      (sum(r[inn]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
    })
  }))
  if (length(cl) == 1) auc <- matrix(auc, nrow = 1, dimnames = list(NULL, colnames(expr)))
  rownames(auc) <- cl
  list(median = med, z = z, auc = auc)
}

# Top markers per cluster in words: highest and lowest AUC.
cluster_summary <- function(cm, cluster, n = 4) {
  cl <- rownames(cm$auc)
  sizes <- table(factor(cluster, levels = cl))
  data.frame(
    cluster = cl,
    cells = as.integer(sizes),
    percent = round(100 * as.numeric(sizes) / length(cluster), 1),
    high = vapply(cl, function(k) {
      a <- sort(cm$auc[k, ], decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(n)]
      paste(sprintf("%s (%.2f)", names(a), a), collapse = ", ")
    }, ""),
    low = vapply(cl, function(k) {
      a <- sort(cm$auc[k, ])[seq_len(n)]
      paste(sprintf("%s (%.2f)", names(a), a), collapse = ", ")
    }, ""),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL
  )
}

# Cluster share within each sample, then mean and SEM across samples per group.
# The per-sample mean is the number to report: pooling lets one large sample
# set the answer.
cluster_proportions <- function(sample, cluster, groups = NULL, exclude = NULL) {
  keep <- !cluster %in% exclude
  tab <- table(sample = sample[keep], cluster = droplevels(as.factor(cluster[keep])))
  pct <- 100 * prop.table(tab, 1)
  per_sample <- as.data.frame.matrix(round(pct, 2))
  per_sample <- cbind(sample = rownames(per_sample), n = as.integer(rowSums(tab)),
                      per_sample)
  if (is.null(groups)) groups <- setNames(rep("all", nrow(pct)), rownames(pct))
  g <- groups[rownames(pct)]
  g[is.na(g)] <- "unassigned"
  summ <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(pct)), g), function(i) {
    x <- pct[i, , drop = FALSE]
    data.frame(group = g[i[1]], cluster = colnames(pct), n_samples = length(i),
               mean = colMeans(x),
               sem = if (length(i) > 1) apply(x, 2, sd) / sqrt(length(i)) else NA_real_,
               pooled = as.numeric(100 * colSums(tab[i, , drop = FALSE]) / sum(tab[i, ])),
               row.names = NULL)
  }))
  list(per_sample = per_sample, summary = summ)
}

# Adjusted Rand index between two partitions.
ari <- function(a, b) {
  t <- table(a, b)
  c2 <- function(x) x * (x - 1) / 2
  s <- sum(c2(t)); sa <- sum(c2(rowSums(t))); sb <- sum(c2(colSums(t)))
  e <- sa * sb / c2(sum(t))
  (s - e) / ((sa + sb) / 2 - e)
}

# ---- one call for the whole run ---------------------------------------------

run_pipeline <- function(fcs_list, ch, cofactor = 6000, max_per_sample = Inf,
                         n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.1, xdim = 8, ydim = 8,
                         balanced = TRUE, max_k = 15, k = 6, seed = 42,
                         progress = function(msg) NULL) {
  sel <- ch[ch$use, ]
  progress("Building matrix")
  dat <- build_matrix(fcs_list, sel$channel, sel$marker, cofactor, max_per_sample, seed)
  Z <- zscore(dat$expr)
  t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  progress("UMAP")
  emb <- run_umap(Z, n_neighbors, min_dist, seed)
  t1 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  progress("SOM")
  som <- run_som(Z, dat$sample, xdim, ydim, balanced, seed = seed)
  progress("Consensus clustering")
  cons <- consensus_hc(som$codes, max_k = max_k, seed = seed)
  t2 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  list(sample = dat$sample, raw = dat$raw, expr = dat$expr, Z = Z,
       umap = emb, som = som, consensus = cons,
       params = list(cofactor = cofactor, max_per_sample = max_per_sample,
                     n_neighbors = n_neighbors, min_dist = min_dist,
                     xdim = xdim, ydim = ydim, balanced = balanced,
                     max_k = max_k, seed = seed, channels = sel$channel,
                     markers = sel$marker),
       timing = c(umap = t1 - t0, cluster = t2 - t1))
}

clusters_at <- function(res, k) res$consensus[[as.character(k)]][res$som$node]
